scope.claim: Every member of the listed official source registries has a local component, style and task-pattern mapping. Counts are separate overlapping registries, not a count of unique user-visible components.
scope.coverage_level: Reference specification and authored examples; native rendering, accessibility and live-device behaviour require separate versioned evidence.
exclusions: Arbitrary custom cards, custom panels, custom More info overrides and custom integrations are not covered by a universal claim.
Integration-specific entity attributes, modes, device classes and actions remain capability-dependent; enumerating a platform does not enumerate every integration.
Internal utility functions, CSS helpers, animation controllers and implementation-only child elements are not independent public interface components.
The additional state-domain list is limited to domains referenced by the pinned row/dialog registries; it is not all Home Assistant integrations.
External app/provider/companion interfaces retain their own implementation and accessibility boundaries.
scope.dynamic_variants: Native-provided modes, favourites, media sources, select options, numerical bounds and permission-dependent actions must be preserved rather than replaced by a guessed fixed list.
